_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("collection" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" TEXT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("collection"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(id = 1), "scope_version" INTEGER NULL, "next_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "resync_tokens" ("collection" TEXT NOT NULL, "stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("collection"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "branches" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "slug" TEXT NULL, "is_mother_church" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_mother_church" IN (0, 1)), "address" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "postal_box" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teaching_types" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "slug" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "visible_on_home" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("visible_on_home" IN (0, 1)), "layout" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contributors" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "bio" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teachings" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NULL, "branch_id" INTEGER NULL, "contributor_id" INTEGER NULL, "teaching_type_id" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_live" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_live" IN (0, 1)), "is_full_service" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_full_service" IN (0, 1)), "playlist_url" TEXT NULL, "download" TEXT NULL, "image_landscape_url" TEXT NULL, "image_portrait_url" TEXT NULL, "image_square_url" TEXT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NULL, "client_created_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teaching_guests" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "teaching_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "contributor_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gathering_types" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "slug" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "visible_on_home" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("visible_on_home" IN (0, 1)), "layout" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gatherings" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NULL, "branch_id" INTEGER NULL, "contributor_id" INTEGER NULL, "teaching_type_id" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_live" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_live" IN (0, 1)), "is_full_service" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_full_service" IN (0, 1)), "playlist_url" TEXT NULL, "image_landscape_url" TEXT NULL, "image_portrait_url" TEXT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NULL, "client_created_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "status_backgrounds" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_color" TEXT NOT NULL, "top_color" TEXT NOT NULL, "bottom_color" TEXT NOT NULL, "ink" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "official_accounts" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "short_name" TEXT NULL, "branch_id" INTEGER NULL, "avatar_url" TEXT NULL, "background_id" INTEGER NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "official_account_memberships" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "announcements" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "branch_id" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "body" TEXT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "background_id" INTEGER NULL, "background_image_url" TEXT NULL, "media_kind" TEXT NULL, "media_url" TEXT NULL, "media_poster_url" TEXT NULL, "media_duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "media_waveform" TEXT NULL, "is_pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pinned" IN (0, 1)), "owner_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playback_progress" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "teaching_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "client_created_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_playback_positions" ("content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "progress_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legal_documents" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_mandatory_version" INTEGER NULL, "sections" TEXT NOT NULL, "published_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "seasons" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "background_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "background_vertical_url" TEXT NULL, "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "ends_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "presentation_vocabulary" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "singular" TEXT NULL, "plural" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_entries" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL, "label_key" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "featured" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("featured" IN (0, 1)), "divided" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("divided" IN (0, 1)), "destination_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination_page" TEXT NULL, "destination_family" TEXT NULL, "destination_rubric" TEXT NULL, "destination_branch" TEXT NULL, "destination_search" TEXT NULL, "destination_series_id" TEXT NULL, "destination_contributor_id" INTEGER NULL, "destination_url" TEXT NULL, "filter_rubric" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("filter_rubric" IN (0, 1)), "filter_branch" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("filter_branch" IN (0, 1)), "filter_family" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("filter_family" IN (0, 1)), "filter_search" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("filter_search" IN (0, 1)), "media_visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("media_visible" IN (0, 1)), "media_position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "home_visible" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("home_visible" IN (0, 1)), "home_position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "home_layout" TEXT NULL, "published_from" INTEGER NULL, "published_until" INTEGER NULL, "page_title" TEXT NULL, "page_description" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_pages" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "label_key" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "destination_family" TEXT NULL, "destination_rubric" TEXT NULL, "destination_branch" TEXT NULL, "destination_search" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_page_chips" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "media_page_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "filter_rubric" TEXT NULL, "filter_branch" TEXT NULL, "filter_search" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_page_sections" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "media_page_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "title_key" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "layout" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort" TEXT NOT NULL, "max_items" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10, "destination_family" TEXT NOT NULL, "destination_rubric" TEXT NULL, "destination_branch" TEXT NULL, "destination_search" TEXT NULL, "manual_ids" TEXT NULL, "ranked_ids" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "decor" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "background_url" TEXT NULL, "background_vertical_url" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "auth_channels" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "email_open" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("email_open" IN (0, 1)), "phone_open" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("phone_open" IN (0, 1)), "login_notice" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_settings" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "update_banner_min_version" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "avatar_url" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "groups" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "join_policy" TEXT NOT NULL, "post_policy" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_write_locked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_write_locked" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "is_direct" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_direct" IN (0, 1)), "owner_id" TEXT NULL, "owner_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_official_account_id" INTEGER NULL, "owner_contributor_id" INTEGER NULL, "member_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_members" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_join_requests" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_messages" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_id" TEXT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "body" TEXT NULL, "client_message_id" TEXT NULL, "client_created_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "edited_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_forwarded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_forwarded" IN (0, 1)), "reply_to_message_id" TEXT NULL, "reply_to_author_id" TEXT NULL, "reply_to_excerpt" TEXT NULL, "reply_to_media_kind" TEXT NULL, "reply_to_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("reply_to_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "media_key" TEXT NULL, "media_kind" TEXT NULL, "media_duration" INTEGER NULL, "media_meta" TEXT NULL, "media_size" INTEGER NULL, "media_mime" TEXT NULL, "media_thumbnail_key" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_group_messages" ("client_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "media_kind" TEXT NULL, "media_path" TEXT NULL, "media_thumb_path" TEXT NULL, "media_mime" TEXT NULL, "media_meta" TEXT NULL, "media_duration" INTEGER NULL, "media_size" INTEGER NULL, "media_key" TEXT NULL, "media_thumbnail_key" TEXT NULL, "media_error" TEXT NULL, "failed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("failed" IN (0, 1)), "reply_to_message_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("client_message_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_reads" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "membership_id" INTEGER NULL, "last_read_message_id" TEXT NULL, "last_read_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_group_reads" ("group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "my_interactions" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_anonymous" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_anonymous" IN (0, 1)), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_id" TEXT NULL, "client_created_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spiritual_notes" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NULL, "teaching_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "content" TEXT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "category_id" TEXT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "client_created_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_categories" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_created_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "teaching_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "content" TEXT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "category_id" TEXT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "client_created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "client_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_note_media" ("note_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "embed_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "thumb_path" TEXT NULL, "mime" TEXT NULL, "size" INTEGER NULL, "duration" INTEGER NULL, "key" TEXT NULL, "thumb_key" TEXT NULL, "error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("note_id", "embed_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_arrangements" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "membership_id" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "pinned_at" INTEGER NULL, "arranged_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_group_arrangements" ("group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "requested_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "message_receipts" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "delivered_at" INTEGER NULL, "read_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "delivery_acks" ("message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("message_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_mutes" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "membership_id" INTEGER NULL, "muted_until" INTEGER NULL, "muted_forever" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("muted_forever" IN (0, 1)), "mute_changed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_message_reactions" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "emoji" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_message_hides" ("sync_stamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "hide_id" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("message_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "downloads" ("content_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "quality" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', "bytes_received" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "bytes_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NULL, "version_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "failure_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "download_titles" ("content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("content_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "download_notifications" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "content_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
